d: STARFARER'S LOG #3 — The Engine Reef. the blue hour over the Wayfarer — and Tredoraia is already three steps ahead. Starring Tredoraia (Nebex Mihollow), Nyquis (Nedine Belmere), Nymarae (Deltine Rikem), Sylxor (Dohollow Beltal). An anthology of voyages: the survey ship Wayfarer charts the far dark, one strange world per issue.
